name: GULAB JAMUN
creator: seirogan (@seirogan)
modifications: Re-encoded with EXT_meshopt_compression; textures resized to 1024 px WebP.
educationalRole: Food → বাংলার খাবার → মিষ্টি: three textured গোলাপজাম (gulab jamun) in syrup in a glass bowl, one real kind of Bangladeshi মিষ্টি.
limitations: One kind of মিষ্টি; রসগোল্লা, চমচম, সন্দেশ and others look different.
The glass bowl, syrup and spoon are modelled; textures reduced to 1024 px WebP.
